Beneath the {wiki:Ancient Temple}, north of Thais, cross the tunnels full of orcs, lower the drawbridge and get past the Bonelords to a hidden hole. Down there, a box holds a {item:Life Ring} and a {item:Dragon Necklace}.
to get out of the hole
In the last hole there are 3 {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} together: the easiest way is to run to the box, grab the reward and climb straight back up with the rope.
Leave **Thais** by the **north** gate: the {wiki:Ancient Temple} is right to the **northwest** of that gate. Enter the temple and go down the steps.
After the steps, follow the path in the image **south** and go down one more floor.
Go **east**, past some {creature:Orc|Orcs}, until you reach water and a drawbridge. If the bridge is down, cross it.
If the bridge is raised, go to the lever: it is **south** of the bridge, through a narrow passage (marked on the map). Pull it to lower the bridge and go back to cross it.
There may be an {creature:Orc Berserker} in this area.
After the bridge continue **east** (past two {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}) and then **south** (two more Bonelords), until you reach a dead end next to the water.
Open the hole with the pick
The pick hole is hidden next to the **west** wall (circled on the map of the drawbridge step). Use the {item:Pick} on that spot and go down.
Down there you will face **3 {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} at the same time**.
The quest box is in the **northeast** corner of the room. Run to it, open it and climb up with the {item:Rope}.

Use the {item:Rope} on the hole to climb back up. Then go back the way you came: **north** and **west** past the {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}, cross the drawbridge again, head **west** past the orcs, go up one floor and go **north** again to the temple steps. You come out northwest of the north gate of **Thais**.
